_comment: Orderly kinematic yield at contact: team 0's Infantry gets a plain move order (no attack target) straight through team 1's held Infantry. Team 0 stays a disengage the whole time -- never is_engaged(), never strikes back -- but team 1 is only on Hold (never chases, still defends where it stands), so it attacks team 0 one-sidedly once in range. Position anchors on the contact-resisted front ranks, and _move_to() itself now yields the into-contact component of an orderly march, so the rear ranks do not keep compressing into the arrested front after ~340. Clip runs to tick 400 so the hold is visible.
